title: Construction HQ Style Pack
summary: 5 furniture items for the construction company office. Hard hats, blueprints, safety cones, toolboxes, tape measures. AOM's target vertical in the game.
content:
Construction HQ Style Pack

Steffen | 2026-03-16 5 items. Built for the builders.

Pack Contents

# Item ID Name Default Room
1 cr-hard-hat Voxel Hard Hat on Hook main-hall, patrik
2 cr-blueprint Voxel Blueprint Roll alex, steve, patrik
3 cr-safety-cone Voxel Safety Cone main-hall
4 cr-toolbox Voxel Toolbox elon, main-hall
5 cr-tape-measure Voxel Tape Measure patrik, steffen

Why This Pack Matters

AOM's target vertical is construction companies. When a contractor signs up for Corner, their office should feel like THEIR office. Hard hats, blueprints, safety cones. This is the first industry-specific expansion pack and validates the marketplace concept: the catalog grows toward each client's reality.

Renders

All 5 items have transparent PNG renders at 128x128px and JSON sidecars with full metadata.
